<p class="hero-description">
I am a PhD Candidate in Biostatistics and Data Analytics at Florida International University. My research focuses on developing and evaluating statistical methods for complex biomedical and public health data.
</p>

<p class="hero-description">
My research interests include statistical inference, regression modeling, multicollinearity, shrinkage estimation, survival analysis, epidemiology, causal inference, and machine learning for health data.
</p>

## Research Areas

:::: {.research-grid}

::: {.research-card}
### Statistical Methodology

Regression modeling, statistical inference, multicollinearity, shrinkage estimation, and Monte Carlo simulation.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Biostatistics & Epidemiology

Statistical methods for biomedical, clinical, epidemiologic, and public health research.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Survival & Longitudinal Analysis

Survival modeling, longitudinal health data, disease progression, and risk prediction.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Machine Learning for Health

Machine learning, predictive modeling, and computational methods for complex health data.
:::
